name: BoldTrail BackOffice (Brokermint)
positioning: Where a closed transaction becomes a commission calculation, an agent statement and an accounting entry.
description: Brokermint — now sold as BoldTrail BackOffice — handles the brokerage side of a deal: commission plans, splits, caps, fees, agent billing, 1099 preparation and accounting export. Transaction management and e-signature sit alongside it so the same file feeds both compliance and money.
real_estate_use: The problem it solves is that commission structures are individually negotiated. A brokerage encodes each agent's split, cap and fee schedule once, and every closing then produces a disbursement authorisation and an agent statement automatically. Year-end 1099 preparation stops being a spreadsheet exercise.
features: Commission plans with splits, caps, tiers and referral fees
Automatic disbursement authorisations and agent statements
Agent billing for monthly fees and chargebacks
Transaction management with document checklists and e-signature
Production reporting by agent, office and team

use_cases.job: Calculate every agent's commission automatically from their negotiated plan
Produce year-end 1099s and agent statements without rebuilding a spreadsheet
